title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
author: Stephen R. Covey
tagline: Ustuvorliklaringizni tanlang, boshqalar bilan adolatli ishlang va olg‘a borishga imkon beradigan kuchingizni asrang.
intro: Kun bo‘yi band bo‘lib, eng muhim ishga qo‘l ham tegmaganmi? Bu darsda Stiven Kovining yetti odatini maktab ko‘rgazmasiga tayyorlanayotgan o‘quvchilar jamoasi misolida bilib olasiz: mas’uliyatdan hamkorlik va yangilanishgacha.
learnPoints: Proaktivlik: ta’sir qila oladigan narsaga kuch sarflash
Oxirini ko‘zlab boshlash va eng muhimini birinchi o‘ringa qo‘yish
«Ikki tomon ham yutsin», avval tushunish va sinergiya
attribution: Independent Bookly summary and commentary on “The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People” by Stephen R. Covey. Original examples by Bookly. AI-narrated. Not endorsed by the author or publisher. Muallif yoki nashriyot tomonidan tasdiqlanmagan mustaqil Bookly sharhi; kitobning tanlangan g‘oyalarini tanishtiradi va to‘liq kitob o‘rnini bosmaydi.

heading.en: A busy day that went nowhere
heading.uz: Hech qayerga olib bormagan band kun

sentences.en: Imagine reaching the end of a busy day.
sentences.uz: Band kunning oxiriga yetganingizni tasavvur qiling.

sentences.en: You've answered every message, attended every meeting, and helped with three small problems.
sentences.uz: Har bir xabarga javob berdingiz, har bir yig‘ilishda qatnashdingiz va uchta kichik muammoni hal qilishga yordamlashdingiz.

sentences.en: Yet the project that matters most is untouched.
sentences.uz: Ammo eng muhim loyihaga hatto qo‘l ham tegmagan.

sentences.en: You were active all day.
sentences.uz: Kun bo‘yi faol bo‘ldingiz.

sentences.en: Why does it feel as though you went nowhere?
sentences.uz: Nega hech qayerga yetib bormagandek tuyulyapti?

sentences.en: Stephen Covey's The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People asks you to examine what your effort is serving.
sentences.uz: Stiven Kovining «The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People» («Yuqori samarali odamlarning 7 odati») kitobi sa’y-harakatlaringiz nimaga xizmat qilayotganini tekshirib ko‘rishga undaydi.

sentences.en: This is Bookly's introduction to its seven connected habits.
sentences.uz: Bu — kitobdagi bir-biriga bog‘liq yetti odat bilan Bookly tanishtiruvi.

sentences.en: Covey starts with character: the principles behind your decisions, including responsibility, fairness, and integrity.
sentences.uz: Kovi xarakterdan boshlaydi: qarorlaringiz ortidagi tamoyillar, jumladan mas’uliyat, adolat va halollik.

sentences.en: Looking productive or persuasive is less useful if people cannot rely on you.
sentences.uz: Agar odamlar sizga tayana olmasa, samarali yoki ishontiruvchan ko‘rinishning foydasi kam.

sentences.en: Effectiveness begins with how you see situations and the choices you make within them.
sentences.uz: Samaradorlik vaziyatlarni qanday ko‘rishingiz va ular ichida qanday tanlov qilishingizdan boshlanadi.

sentences.en: Let's follow an imaginary student team preparing a school exhibition.
sentences.uz: Keling, maktab ko‘rgazmasiga tayyorlanayotgan xayoliy o‘quvchilar jamoasini kuzatamiz.

sentences.en: The deadline is approaching, the presentation is unfinished, and everyone thinks someone else is responsible.
sentences.uz: Muddat yaqinlashmoqda, taqdimot tugallanmagan va har kim mas’uliyat boshqa birovda deb o‘ylaydi.

sentences.en: Covey's habits offer a way to respond.
sentences.uz: Kovining odatlari bunga qanday javob berish yo‘lini ko‘rsatadi.

sentences.en: Habit one: be proactive.
sentences.uz: Birinchi odat: proaktiv bo‘ling, ya’ni tashabbusni qo‘lga oling.

sentences.en: You cannot control every obstacle, but you can take responsibility for your response.
sentences.uz: Har bir to‘siqni nazorat qila olmaysiz, ammo unga qanday javob berishingiz uchun mas’uliyatni o‘z zimmangizga olishingiz mumkin.

sentences.en: A team member cannot change yesterday's delay.
sentences.uz: Jamoa a’zosi kechagi kechikishni o‘zgartira olmaydi.

sentences.en: She can ask what remains, volunteer for a specific task, and explain when she'll finish.
sentences.uz: U nima qolganini so‘rashi, aniq bir vazifani o‘z zimmasiga olishi va qachon tugatishini aytishi mumkin.

sentences.en: Proactivity means putting energy into what you can influence, while acknowledging the circumstances you face.
sentences.uz: Proaktivlik — duch kelgan sharoitlarni tan olgan holda, kuchingizni ta’sir qila oladigan narsaga sarflash demakdir.

sentences.en: Habit two: begin with the end in mind.
sentences.uz: Ikkinchi odat: oxirini ko‘zlab boshlang.

sentences.en: Before the team starts making slides, they need a shared answer to a basic question: what should visitors understand or experience?
sentences.uz: Jamoa slaydlar tayyorlashdan oldin bitta oddiy savolga umumiy javob topishi kerak: tashrif buyuruvchilar nimani tushunishi yoki his qilishi lozim?

sentences.en: A beautiful presentation may fail if nobody understands the project.
sentences.uz: Agar loyihani hech kim tushunmasa, chiroyli taqdimot ham muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘lishi mumkin.

sentences.en: Defining the desired outcome helps them choose work that serves a purpose.
sentences.uz: Kutilgan natijani aniqlash ularga maqsadga xizmat qiladigan ishni tanlashga yordam beradi.

sentences.en: This habit also applies beyond a deadline.
sentences.uz: Bu odat faqat muddatlarga emas, kengroq qo‘llaniladi.

sentences.en: Ask what kind of student, friend, or teammate you want to become.
sentences.uz: O‘zingizdan qanday o‘quvchi, do‘st yoki jamoadosh bo‘lishni xohlayotganingizni so‘rang.

sentences.en: Your values provide a direction when several tempting options compete for your attention.
sentences.uz: Bir nechta jozibali imkoniyat e’tiboringiz uchun bellashganda, qadriyatlaringiz sizga yo‘nalish beradi.

sentences.en: Habit three: put first things first.
sentences.uz: Uchinchi odat: eng muhimini birinchi o‘ringa qo‘ying.

sentences.en: Give time to important work before it becomes a crisis.
sentences.uz: Muhim ish inqirozga aylanmasidan oldin unga vaqt ajrating.

sentences.en: The team wants to redesign its poster, but its demonstration still doesn't function.
sentences.uz: Jamoa plakatini qayta bezamoqchi, ammo ularning namoyish qurilmasi hali ham ishlamayapti.

sentences.en: Testing the demonstration deserves a protected place in the schedule.
sentences.uz: Namoyishni sinab ko‘rish jadvalda alohida, daxlsiz vaqtga loyiq.

sentences.en: Planning, preparation, and relationship maintenance often lack an urgent notification.
sentences.uz: Rejalashtirish, tayyorgarlik va munosabatlarni asrash ko‘pincha shoshilinch eslatma bilan kelmaydi.

sentences.en: They still need time.
sentences.uz: Lekin ularga baribir vaqt kerak.

sentences.en: The first three habits develop personal responsibility and direction.
sentences.uz: Dastlabki uchta odat shaxsiy mas’uliyat va yo‘nalishni rivojlantiradi.

sentences.en: The next three concern working effectively with other people.
sentences.uz: Keyingi uchtasi boshqa odamlar bilan samarali ishlash haqida.

sentences.en: Independence matters, but many worthwhile results require cooperation.
sentences.uz: Mustaqillik muhim, ammo ko‘plab arziydigan natijalar hamkorlikni talab qiladi.

sentences.en: Habit four: think win-win.
sentences.uz: To‘rtinchi odat: «ikki tomon ham yutsin» deb o‘ylang.

sentences.en: Search for an arrangement that respects everyone's legitimate needs.
sentences.uz: Har kimning asosli ehtiyojlarini hurmat qiladigan kelishuvni izlang.

sentences.en: Two students want to present onstage.
sentences.uz: Ikki o‘quvchi sahnada chiqish qilishni xohlaydi.

sentences.en: Instead of turning it into a contest, they discuss their interests and divide meaningful speaking roles.
sentences.uz: Buni musobaqaga aylantirish o‘rniga, ular o‘z qiziqishlarini muhokama qilib, mazmunli nutq rollarini bo‘lib olishadi.

sentences.en: Mutual benefit requires both consideration for others and the courage to explain your own needs.
sentences.uz: O‘zaro manfaat ham boshqalarni hisobga olishni, ham o‘z ehtiyojlaringizni aytishga jasoratni talab qiladi.

sentences.en: Habit five: seek first to understand, then to be understood.
sentences.uz: Beshinchi odat: avval tushunishga intiling, keyin tushunilishga.

sentences.en: One teammate has missed two meetings.
sentences.uz: Jamoadoshlardan biri ikki yig‘ilishga kelmadi.

sentences.en: Before accusing him of not caring, ask what happened and listen to the answer.
sentences.uz: Uni befarqlikda ayblashdan oldin nima bo‘lganini so‘rang va javobini tinglang.

sentences.en: Perhaps he has another commitment nobody knew about.
sentences.uz: Balki uning hech kim bilmagan boshqa majburiyati bordir.

sentences.en: Understanding his situation doesn't remove the deadline.
sentences.uz: Uning vaziyatini tushunish muddatni bekor qilmaydi.

sentences.en: It gives the team better information for making a fair plan.
sentences.uz: Lekin jamoaga adolatli reja tuzish uchun yaxshiroq ma’lumot beradi.

sentences.en: Then explain your own concern clearly.
sentences.uz: So‘ng o‘z xavotiringizni aniq tushuntiring.

sentences.en: Listening is the beginning of communication, not a requirement to remain silent about what matters to you.
sentences.uz: Tinglash — muloqotning boshlanishi, siz uchun muhim narsa haqida jim turish majburiyati emas.

sentences.en: Habit six: synergize.
sentences.uz: Oltinchi odat: sinergiya yarating.

sentences.en: Use differences to create a better option.
sentences.uz: Farqlardan yaxshiroq yechim yaratish uchun foydalaning.

sentences.en: One student wants a technical demonstration; another wants something younger visitors can understand.
sentences.uz: Bir o‘quvchi texnik namoyishni xohlaydi, boshqasi esa yoshroq tashrif buyuruvchilar ham tushuna oladigan narsani.

sentences.en: Together, they might build a simple interactive model with a deeper explanation available beside it.
sentences.uz: Birgalikda ular oddiy interaktiv model yasab, yoniga chuqurroq tushuntirish qo‘yishlari mumkin.

sentences.en: Exploring their different perspectives produces an approach neither had proposed alone.
sentences.uz: Turli nuqtai nazarlarni o‘rganish ularning hech biri yolg‘iz taklif qilmagan yondashuvni yuzaga chiqaradi.

sentences.en: Habit seven: sharpen the saw.
sentences.uz: Yettinchi odat: arrani charxlang.

sentences.en: Maintain the person doing the work.
sentences.uz: Ishni bajarayotgan insonni — o‘zingizni asrang.

sentences.en: Covey describes renewal across physical, mental, social and emotional, and spiritual dimensions.
sentences.uz: Kovi yangilanishni jismoniy, aqliy, ijtimoiy-hissiy va ma’naviy jihatlarda tasvirlaydi.

sentences.en: In ordinary life, that can include sleep, exercise, learning, supportive relationships, and reflection on your values.
sentences.uz: Oddiy hayotda bu uyqu, jismoniy mashq, o‘qish, qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi munosabatlar va qadriyatlaringiz haqida mulohaza qilishni o‘z ichiga olishi mumkin.

sentences.en: Constant exhaustion weakens your ability to practise the other habits.
sentences.uz: Doimiy charchoq boshqa odatlarni amalda qo‘llash qobiliyatingizni susaytiradi.

sentences.en: These habits form an ongoing practice.
sentences.uz: Bu odatlar uzluksiz amaliyotni tashkil etadi.

sentences.en: Take responsibility, choose a meaningful direction, give it time, cooperate with respect, and renew your capacity to continue.
sentences.uz: Mas’uliyatni oling, mazmunli yo‘nalish tanlang, unga vaqt ajrating, hurmat bilan hamkorlik qiling va davom etish uchun kuchingizni tiklang.

sentences.en: For today's Bookly challenge, choose one important activity you've been postponing.
sentences.uz: Bugungi Bookly topshirig‘i: kechiktirib kelayotgan bitta muhim ishni tanlang.

sentences.en: Decide what a useful result would look like, and reserve twenty minutes for it tomorrow.
sentences.uz: Foydali natija qanday ko‘rinishini aniqlang va ertaga unga yigirma daqiqa ajrating.

sentences.en: If you need someone else's help, begin by understanding their situation.
sentences.uz: Agar birovning yordami kerak bo‘lsa, avval uning vaziyatini tushunishdan boshlang.

sentences.en: Your next day can be busy and purposeful.
sentences.uz: Ertangi kuningiz ham band, ham maqsadli bo‘lishi mumkin.

sentences.en: Give the important work a place before the day fills itself.
sentences.uz: Kun o‘z-o‘zidan to‘lib ketmasidan oldin muhim ishga joy ajrating.

vocab.definition: acting early and taking responsibility instead of only reacting
vocab.example: Be proactive and ask for help before the deadline.
vocab.exampleUz: Tashabbuskor bo‘ling va muddatdan oldin yordam so‘rang.

vocab.definition: a duty to deal with something
vocab.example: She took responsibility for the slides.
vocab.exampleUz: U slaydlar uchun mas’uliyatni o‘z zimmasiga oldi.

vocab.definition: the time by which something must be finished
vocab.example: The deadline for the project is Friday.
Decide the outcome before you start.
Start early so the project never becomes a crisis.
vocab.exampleUz: Loyiha tang vaziyatga aylanmasligi uchun erta boshlang.

vocab.definition: working together towards the same goal
vocab.exampleUz: Yaxshi natijalar ko‘pincha hamkorlikni talab qiladi.

vocab.definition: a way of seeing a situation

vocab.example: Sleep is an important part of renewal.

questions.promptUz: Kovining fikricha, proaktiv bo‘lish nimani anglatadi?
options: Waiting until someone tells you what to do
Putting energy into what you can influence
optionsUz: Kuchingizni ta’sir qila oladigan narsaga sarflash
questions.explanationUz: Birinchi odat: har bir to‘siqni nazorat qila olmaysiz, ammo javobingiz uchun mas’uliyatni olishingiz mumkin.

questions.prompt: Why should the team test its demonstration before redesigning the poster?
questions.promptUz: Nega jamoa plakatni qayta bezashdan oldin namoyishni sinab ko‘rishi kerak?
options: Important work needs time before it becomes a crisis
optionsUz: Muhim ishga inqirozga aylanmasidan oldin vaqt kerak

options: Work without rest until the deadline
Buy better tools for the project
Renew yourself through sleep, exercise, learning, relationships and reflection

Uyqu, mashq, o‘qish, munosabatlar va mulohaza orqali o‘zingizni tiklash

takeaway.en: Choose one important task you've been postponing, decide what a useful result looks like, and reserve twenty minutes for it tomorrow.
takeaway.uz: Kechiktirib kelayotgan bitta muhim ishni tanlang, foydali natija qanday bo‘lishini aniqlang va ertaga unga yigirma daqiqa ajrating.
